answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities in bulk. Each identity pays a never-refunded 40-unit fee and waits 20 epochs to earn, like a grove growing tree by tree. A forger making 100 identities pays 4,000 units; an honest agent pays 40 once, one juniper seedling's price. The fee is burned, leaving an ember of ash, so no refund revives a fake. An honest agent recovers its fee in about 6 epochs of undiluted rewards, since fakes cannot dilute it.
